use py:urllib.parse as urls
foreign urls.unquote(Text) -> Text
use net:System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex as Rx
use js:"node:path/posix" as path
use js:semver as sv

unit kb
unit mb = 1024 kb

record Artifact {
    raw_path: Text
    channel: Text
    size_kb: Int
}

record Request {
    min_range: Text
    budget_mb: Float
    artifacts: List[Artifact]
}

record ParsedArtifact {
    pkg: Text
    ver: Text
    norm: Text
    channel: Text
    size_kb: Int
    format_ok: Bool
    ver_valid: Bool
    semver_ok: Bool
}

let path_regex = "^[a-z0-9-]+/[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+(-[a-z0-9.]+)?$"

fn valid_channel(ch: Text) -> Bool pure =
    ch == "stable" or ch == "beta" or ch == "lts"

fn size_tier(size_kb: Int) -> Text pure = cases size_kb {
    < 100 => "tiny"
    <= 1000 => "standard"
    <= 5000 => "large"
    else => "oversize"
}

fn is_lts_exempt(a: ParsedArtifact) -> Bool pure =
    a.format_ok and a.channel == "lts" and str_contains(a.pkg, "security") and a.ver_valid and str_contains(a.ver, "-") == false and size_tier(a.size_kb) != "oversize"

fn is_eligible(a: ParsedArtifact) -> Bool pure =
    (a.format_ok and a.semver_ok and size_tier(a.size_kb) != "oversize") or is_lts_exempt(a)

fn became_exempt(a: ParsedArtifact) -> Bool pure =
    is_lts_exempt(a) and a.semver_ok == false

fn parse_artifact(a: Artifact, min_range: Text) -> ParsedArtifact =
    let decoded = urls.unquote(a.raw_path) in
    let norm = path.normalize(decoded) in
    let ver = path.basename(norm) in
    let pkg = path.dirname(norm) in
    let format_ok = Rx.IsMatch(norm, path_regex) and valid_channel(a.channel) in
    let valid_ver = sv.valid(ver) ?? "" in
    let ver_valid = valid_ver != "" in
    let semver_ok = if ver_valid == false then false else sv.satisfies(valid_ver, min_range) in
    ParsedArtifact(
        pkg: pkg,
        ver: ver,
        norm: norm,
        channel: a.channel,
        size_kb: a.size_kb,
        format_ok: format_ok,
        ver_valid: ver_valid,
        semver_ok: semver_ok
    )

let req: Request = from_json(stdin_text())
let parsed = [parse_artifact(a, req.min_range) for a in req.artifacts]

let evaluated = [
    record {
        pkg: x.pkg,
        ver: x.ver,
        channel: x.channel,
        size_kb: x.size_kb,
        tier: size_tier(x.size_kb),
        eligible: is_eligible(x),
        exempt: became_exempt(x)
    }
    for x in parsed
]

let summary = summarize x in evaluated {
    total: count
    eligible: count where x.eligible
    exempt: count where x.exempt
    oversize: count where x.tier == "oversize"
    total_kb: sum x.size_kb
    max_kb: max x.size_kb default 0
    eligible_kb: sum x.size_kb where x.eligible
}

let budget: Float[mb] = req.budget_mb as mb
let budget_kb: Float[kb] = budget to kb
let eligible_size: Float[kb] = to_float(summary.eligible_kb) as kb
let within_budget = eligible_size <= budget_kb

let consecutive_rejects = count adjacent past, now in evaluated where past.eligible == false and now.eligible == false
let freeze = consecutive_rejects >= 2

let eligible_versions = [x.ver for x in evaluated where x.eligible]
let recommended = sv.maxSatisfying(eligible_versions, ">=0.0.0")

let output = record {
    total: summary.total,
    eligible: summary.eligible,
    oversize: summary.oversize,
    total_kb: summary.total_kb,
    max_kb: summary.max_kb,
    consecutive_rejects,
    freeze,
    exempt: summary.exempt,
    eligible_kb: summary.eligible_kb,
    within_budget,
    recommended
}

print json_encode(output)
